caption: Distribution of gating scores under different constraints for SDPA output gating variants.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира разпределението на стойностите на гейтинга (gating scores) за различни статистически мерки — средна стойност (mean), стандартно отклонение (std), минимална (min) и максимална (max) стойност — във връзка с броя на слоевете (layer) при SDPA output gating варианти. Оста X, означена като „layer“, представлява номера на слоя и варира от 0 до 22 с равномерни интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като „gate value“, показва стойностите на гейтинга и е масштабирана линейно от 0.0 до 1.0 с интервали от 0.2. Четирите линии в графиката са: червена плътна линия, представляваща max, която започва при стойност около 0.99 при слой 0 и остава почти постоянна на ниво 1.0 до края; синя пунктирана линия за mean, която започва близо до 0.0, постепенно нараства до около 0.2 при слой 15, след което спада до 0.05 при слой 22; оранжева точкована линия за std, която следва подобна тенденция като mean, но с по-голяма амплитуда на колебанията, достигайки връх около 0.2 при слой 20; и зелена пунктирана линия за min, която остава почти непроменена на ниво 0.0 през целия диапазон на слоевете.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart, titled “atten_output_gate values,” displays the distribution of gating scores across different layers for SDPA output gating variants, as referenced in the paper on Gated Attention for Large Language Models. The x-axis, labeled “layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with linear spacing and no explicit unit, marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “gate value,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with linear scaling and no unit, marked at intervals of 0.2. Four distinct lines are plotted: the red solid line labeled “max” remains consistently near 1.0 across all layers, showing minimal fluctuation. The blue dashed line labeled “mean” begins near 0.05 at layer 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.2 by layer 15, then fluctuates between 0.1 and 0.2 through layer 23. The orange dotted line labeled “std” starts near 0.05, increases to around 0.1 by layer 10, peaks near 0.2 at layer 20, and exhibits sharp drops and rises toward the end. The green dash-dotted line labeled “min” remains flat at 0.0 across the entire range of layers.
model_annotations.German: The line chart titled “atten_output_gate values” displays the distribution of gating scores across model layers for four statistical measures—mean, standard deviation (std), minimum (min), and maximum (max)—as applied to SDPA output gating variants. The x-axis, labeled “layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 5, representing discrete transformer layer indices. The y-axis, labeled “gate value,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, indicating normalized gating scores. The red solid line representing “max” remains consistently near 1.0 across all layers, showing minimal variation and peaking slightly above 0.98 at layer 0 before stabilizing. The blue dashed line for “mean” begins near 0.02 at layer 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.18 by layer 15, then fluctuates between 0.10 and 0.20 through layer 22, with a local peak near 0.20 at layer 20. The orange dotted line for “std” starts near 0.03 at layer 0, increases to around 0.10 by layer 10, and continues rising with irregular oscillations, reaching approximately 0.18 at layer 20 before dropping to 0.10 at layer 22. The green dash-dotted line for “min” remains flat at 0.0 across all layers, indicating no positive minimum gate value is observed at any layer.
